zh: 华中科技大学 · 通信工程本科生
智能电磁调控 · 可信人工智能 · 无线通信系统
en: Intelligent EM Wave Manipulation · Trustworthy AI · Wireless Communication Systems

zh: 我是谢秋实，目前就读于华中科技大学（中国 🇨🇳）通信工程专业，已推免至浙江大学（中国 🇨🇳）信息与电子工程学院，拟于 2027 年在赵纪伟研究员指导下攻读博士学位。我的科研与工程实践主要围绕智能电磁调控、可信人工智能与无线通信系统展开，关注智能算法与软硬件系统的结合。
本科期间，我曾在浙江大学（中国 🇨🇳）、北京大学（中国 🇨🇳）和华中科技大学（中国 🇨🇳）的多个课题组参与科研实习，也参与了与北京交通大学（中国 🇨🇳）、西安电子科技大学（中国 🇨🇳）、中国科学院大学（中国 🇨🇳）及拉筹伯大学（澳大利亚 🇦🇺）研究人员合作的科研项目。我的研究经历涉及超表面、多模态人工智能与智能信息系统等方向。
在科研之外，我也积极参与电子设计、嵌入式系统与智能硬件相关的竞赛和项目开发，并在多项竞赛中担任队长。本科期间，我曾获国家奖学金及十余项学科竞赛奖励，包括 2 项全国二等奖、2 项省级一等奖。
这里收录了我的科研论文、竞赛项目与个人作品。欢迎交流研究想法，也欢迎围绕相关方向开展合作！
en: I am Qiushi Xie (谢秋实), an undergraduate student in Communication Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)（China 🇨🇳）. I have been admitted to the direct-entry Ph.D. program at the College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang University (ZJU)（China 🇨🇳）, and expect to begin my doctoral studies in 2027 under the supervision of Dr. Jiwei Zhao. My research and engineering interests broadly span intelligent electromagnetic wave manipulation, trustworthy AI, and wireless communication systems, with a particular interest in integrating intelligent algorithms with hardware and software systems.

During my undergraduate studies, I have undertaken research internships with groups at Zhejiang University（China 🇨🇳）, Peking University（China 🇨🇳）, and HUST（China 🇨🇳）. I have also contributed to collaborative research projects involving researchers from Beijing Jiaotong University（China 🇨🇳）, Xidian University（China 🇨🇳）, the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences（China 🇨🇳）, and La Trobe University（Australia 🇦🇺）. My research experience covers metasurfaces, multimodal AI, and intelligent information systems.

Alongside research, I actively participate in engineering competitions and hands-on projects in electronic design, embedded systems, and intelligent hardware, and have served as team leader in several competitions. I have received the National Scholarship and more than ten awards in student competitions, including two national second prizes and two provincial first prizes.
This website brings together my research papers, competition projects, and personal work. Feel free to get in touch to exchange ideas or explore potential collaborations!
